name: ai-context-meter
title: AI Context Meter
description: A slim prompt-footer bar shows how full the model's context window is, as a small ring and a percentage beside the model name. Clicking it opens a panel that breaks the used tokens down by source and offers to compact the conversation.
use: An AI chat composer needs to show how much context is left and let people inspect or shrink it.
avoid: The panel is a fixed 288px wide and opens upward, so it needs room above the composer on short screens.
a11y: The trigger is labelled with its percentage and opens as a button; Escape returns focus. Hover-only row highlighting has no keyboard equivalent. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: At rest a dark rounded footer bar holds a model name on the left and a tiny circular gauge with a percentage on the right. Open, a dark rounded panel floats above: a Context heading with a token total, a thin stacked colour bar ticked at the compact point, rows of swatches with token counts, and a Compact now button.
behaves: The ring fills and the number rolls as tokens arrive, and the percentage shifts to amber then red near the threshold. Clicking the percentage opens the breakdown above the bar; hovering a bar segment dims the others. Escape or an outside click closes it.
customise: Pass segments with labels, token counts and colour classes, plus limit, compactAt, model name, defaultOpen and onCompact. Custom segments without a colour fall back to a fixed grey ramp.
weight: light: A few tweened numbers and one small SVG ring; the demo's growth timer pauses offscreen.
